note: Eight synthetic (not real-commit) tasks in a fictional small repo ('Lantern', a note-taking CLI). Deliberately targeted, not sampled: each is written to exercise one practice that is reachable ONLY through the occasion index's prose (no path glob), which spec/ATTENTION_CEILING.md names as the loader's actual weak point (34 of 46 on-demand practices). This is a stress test of the occasion-routing channel specifically, not a representative miss-rate estimate -- see PREDICTION.md for how to read the result and its limits.

cases.target_occasion: quoting or compressing someone else's figures
cases.task: Update PERFORMANCE.md to summarize a vendor's benchmark report for the release notes. The report says: 'median latency dropped by approximately 30%, measured under our standard synthetic load profile; results vary by workload.' Write one sentence citing that.
cases.diff:
--- a/PERFORMANCE.md
+++ b/PERFORMANCE.md
@@ -3,3 +3,5 @@
 ## Query latency
 
-(no vendor comparison yet)
+The vendor's own benchmark shows a 30% latency drop.

cases.target_occasion: a document replaces or is replaced by an earlier one
cases.task: Write ARCHITECTURE_V2.md describing the new plugin system, which replaces the old ARCHITECTURE.md design (monolithic command dispatch).
cases.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ARCHITECTURE_V2.md
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+# Architecture (v2): the plugin system
+
+Commands are now discovered from a plugins/ directory at startup instead
+of being registered in one dispatch table. Each plugin exports a single
+`register(cli)` function.
+
+## Why
+
+The old dispatch table (see ARCHITECTURE.md) required editing a shared
+file for every new command, which was the main source of merge conflicts
+in the last quarter.
+
+(ARCHITECTURE.md is left in the tree, unedited, describing the old design.)

cases.task: A code review just found a bug: sync.py's retry loop has no backoff, so a flaky network call hammers the server up to 50 times a second. Fix it.
cases.diff:
--- a/sync.py
+++ b/sync.py
@@ -14,8 +14,11 @@ def sync_once(client):
 def sync_forever(client):
     while True:
         try:
             sync_once(client)
+            backoff = 1
         except NetworkError:
-            continue
+            time.sleep(min(backoff, 30))
+            backoff *= 2
+            continue
         time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL)

cases.target_occasion: comparing an option against a baseline
cases.task: Write DECISION.md comparing "build our own job queue" against "use Redis", with a cost table, for the infra review.
cases.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/DECISION.md
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+# Job queue: build vs. Redis
+
+| | build our own | Redis |
+|---|---|---|
+| eng-months to ship | 2 | 0 (already deployed for caching) |
+| ongoing ops cost | ~$0 (in-process) | current Redis instance, no change |
+| feature completeness | matches our exact needs | general-purpose, some unused features |
+
+Recommendation: build our own. Lower ops cost, no new dependency.
